name: Intalk.io
description_en:
inTalk.io is Agami Tech’s modular customer-experience platform combining contact-centre calling,IVR,AI voice bots,voice streaming,analytics and digital engagement. Its homepage offers cloud,on-premise and hybrid hosting. Those options do not establish that every AI model,telephony provider or helpdesk component is included in one plan or processes data in the same place.

For an illustrative callback operation,a team could select a predictive/progressive campaign,apply time-zone and suppression rules,record a disposition and write call notes to HubSpot Contact Activity. A voice bot is a separate conversational path;Voice Streaming supplies infrastructure for connecting AI platforms. No call,campaign,IVR branch,bot,audio sample,HubSpot write,API stream,purchase or export was executed.
description_zh:
inTalk.io是Agami Tech模块化客户体验平台，结合联络中心电话、IVR、AI语音机器人、语音流、分析及数字互动。主页提供云、本地及混合托管，但不证明每种AI模型、电话服务商或帮助台组件都含在一个方案内，或在相同地点处理资料。

假设回拨作业可选择预测／渐进活动，应用时区和屏蔽规则，记录处置，并将备注写入HubSpot联系人活动。语音机器人是独立会话路径，Voice Streaming则提供连接AI平台的基础设施。未执行电话、活动、IVR分支、机器人、音频样例、HubSpot写入、API流、购买或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Predictive/progressive dialing,time-zone and DNC controls,multilevel outcomes and monitoring are described.
core_features.explanation_zh: 描述预测／渐进拨号、时区及DNC控制、多层结果和监控。

core_features.explanation_en: Design menu branches with dynamic logic,TTS,API integration and office/holiday messages.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用动态逻辑、TTS、API及工作／假日消息设计菜单分支。

core_features.explanation_en: Make calls inside HubSpot and update Contact Activity with notes and dispositions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在HubSpot内拨号，并以备注及处置更新联系人活动。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate the conversational bot/human escalation from live audio infrastructure connecting AI models.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分会话机器人／转人工，与连接AI模型的实时音频设施。

en: A sales/support team joining campaign calling and HubSpot contact history.
An implementation team evaluating IVR,AI handoff and external voice-processing infrastructure as separate scopes.
zh: 衔接活动电话与HubSpot联系人历史的销售／支持团队。
分别评估IVR、AI转接及外部语音处理设施的实施团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow fit,not verified conversion,latency or compliance.

Voice platform boundary.en: Voice Streaming is described as telephony and live audio infrastructure for AI platforms,with APIs/SDKs. Formats,authentication,reconnect/backpressure,regions and measured latency were not established.
Voice platform boundary.zh: Voice Streaming描述为AI平台电话及实时音频设施，提供API／SDK；格式、认证、重连／背压、地区及实测延迟未建立。

steps.en: Choose deployment,calling/AI/streaming modules,telephony provider and commercial plan;define retention and contact permissions.
steps.zh: 选择部署、电话／AI／语音流模块、电话服务商及商业方案，定义留存和联系权限。

steps.en: Configure one campaign or IVR branch with dispositions,hours,DNC and an explicit human/failure fallback.
steps.zh: 配置一个活动或IVR分支，设处置、时间、DNC及明确人工／失败兜底。

steps.en: Verify one resulting HubSpot Contact Activity and recording;test failed writes,no-agent handoff and export before wider rollout.
steps.zh: 核对一条HubSpot联系人活动及录音，扩展前测试写入失败、无客服转接及导出。

items.en: A menu-based IVR,conversational bot and live voice stream are separate capabilities with different implementation and failure paths.
items.zh: 菜单IVR、会话机器人及实时语音流不同，实施和失败路径也不同。

items.en: Zero-latency,zero-dropoff and compliance claims were not supported by measured performance,independent certification or executed failover.
items.zh: 零延迟、零流失及合规主张未有实测性能、独立认证或故障切换执行支持。

items.en: Published service terms require separate written agreement for protected health information and say phone service does not support emergency calls.
items.zh: 公开服务条款要求受保护健康信息另获书面同意，并称电话服务不支持紧急呼叫。

items.en: Actual subscription,telephony,analytics and AI amounts,trial duration,minimum and region-specific limits remain unknown.
items.zh: 真实订阅、电话、分析及AI金额、试用期、最低量及地区限制未知。

items.en: After termination or an unconverted trial,the published export-assistance window is14days;subsequent deletion may be irrecoverable.
items.zh: 终止或试用未转付费后，公开导出协助窗口为14天，之后删除可能不可恢复。

license.notes_zh: 期限内有限、非独占、可撤销内部企业访问，移动许可不可转移，厂商保留软件知识产权且禁止反编译，未读部署专属订单。

pricing.billing_basis: Service-plan subscription paid in advance,automatic equal-length renewal;actualamount/unit/termsetbyformnotreviewed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 核对真实计费条件，未取得固定价格。订阅预付、自动续约，一般不退但有明确例外；电话及分析可另收费、税另计。降级当月差额记账户余额而非现金退，终止可能仍欠剩余期限费用，厂商未纠正违约除外。条款承认试用但期限／卡／分钟未知，未归一化全包月价。

faq.question_en: Does the HubSpot page prove every CRM object is synchronized?
faq.question_zh: HubSpot页证明所有CRM对象同步吗？
faq.answer_en: It specifically describes calls,notes,dispositions and recordings inside HubSpot,including Contact Activity updates. Deals,custom objects and historical synchronization were not established.
faq.answer_zh: 它具体描述HubSpot内电话、备注、处置及录音，含联系人活动更新，未建立交易、自定义对象或历史同步。

faq.question_en: Does an emergency-alert use case make this an emergency phone service?
faq.question_zh: 紧急通知场景就意味着可作紧急电话服务吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The streaming page markets alerts,but the service terms explicitly say its phone service is not intended to carry emergency calls. That contractual boundary should remain visible.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。语音流页宣传通知，但服务条款明确电话服务不承载紧急呼叫，应保留这个合同边界。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Separate the communications layer from the AI application
sections.en:
inTalk.io presents a modular platform with contact-centre calling,IVR,BOT AI,INSIGHT AI,workflow automation and digital engagement. It also offers Voice Streaming as telephony and real-time audio infrastructure for connecting other AI platforms. A buyer must identify which component handles the phone connection,which runs the conversation and which stores the customer record;one umbrella platform does not prove one shared entitlement.

Cloud,on-premise and hybrid hosting are offered on the homepage,but optional processors,carriers and integrations still need a deployment-specific data map. Generic healthcare,finance and emergency-alert use cases are not blanket permission to submit regulated data or rely on emergency calling. The published service terms require written agreement for protected health information and exclude emergency-phone use.
sections.zh:
inTalk.io提供模块化电话、IVR、BOT AI、INSIGHT AI、流程自动化及数字互动，也将Voice Streaming作为连接其他AI平台的电话及实时音频基础设施。购买方需明确谁负责电话连接、谁运行会话、谁保存客户记录；同一平台不证明共享全部权益。

主页提供云、本地及混合托管，但可选处理方、运营商及集成仍需按部署画资料流。泛健康、财务及紧急通知场景不是提交监管资料或依赖紧急电话的通行许可，公开服务条款要求受保护健康信息另获书面同意，且排除紧急电话用途。

sections.title_en: Use different controls for outbound pacing and inbound decisions
sections.title_zh: 外呼节奏与呼入决策使用不同控制
sections.en:
Outbound pages describe predictive and progressive modes,time-zone rules,DNC lists,recording and multilevel dispositions. The FAQ distinguishes calling ahead based on expected agent availability from one-by-one dialing and pre-call preview. These descriptions support a campaign design,but do not establish exact retry intervals,abandonment calculation or maximum attempts. The section headed Automated Broadcast actually describes CRM screen pops;that label alone is not evidence of a broadcast delivery workflow.

The IVR designer supports conditional branches,third-party APIs,TTS and office/holiday messages. An illustrative order-status flow should define no input,invalid input,an unavailable API,closed hours and a human queue with nobody available. Menu-based IVR and natural-language voice bots are explicitly distinguished. Route logic and DNC controls help implement a policy;they do not independently establish lawful contact permission or guaranteed resolution.
sections.zh:
外呼页描述预测及渐进模式、时区、DNC名单、录音和多层处置，FAQ区分按预计客服可用情况提前拨号、逐一拨号及拨号前预览。这可支持设计活动，但未建立重试间隔、弃接算法或最大次数。Automated Broadcast标题下实际写CRM弹屏，不能单凭标签认定广播送达流程。

IVR设计器支持条件分支、第三方API、TTS和工作／假日消息。假设订单查询应定义无输入、无效输入、API不可用、非工作时间及人工队列无人。菜单IVR与自然语言机器人明确不同；路由及DNC控制帮助落实政策，不独立建立合法联系许可或保证解决。

sections.title_en: Prove the saved HubSpot contact activity
sections.title_zh: 验证保存的HubSpot联系人活动
sections.en:
The HubSpot integration page gives a concrete scope:make calls inside HubSpot using an existing number,save notes and dispositions to Contact Activity,and listen to recordings in the CRM. That is more useful than a generic integration logo,but it does not establish synchronization of Deals,custom objects or every historical interaction.

For an illustrative sales follow-up,match the intended contact,place one permitted test call,select a disposition and compare the saved note,recording access and timestamp. Test duplicate contacts,missing permissions and a failed write before treating a completed call as a completed CRM task. The reviewed material does not specify authentication,field mapping,idempotency,retry queues or conflict resolution. No CRM account was connected.
sections.zh:
HubSpot集成页给出具体范围：用既有号码在HubSpot内拨号，将备注及处置存入联系人活动，并在CRM听录音。这比泛集成标志具体，但不建立交易、自定义对象或所有历史互动同步。

假设销售跟进需匹配目标联系人，拨一通获准测试电话，选处置，再比对保存备注、录音访问及时间。将完成电话视为完成CRM任务前，应测重复联系人、缺权限及写入失败。已读材料未说明认证、字段映射、幂等、重试队列及冲突处理，未连接CRM账户。

sections.title_en: A bot handoff and a live audio stream need separate failure tests
sections.title_zh: 机器人转接与实时语音流需分别测失败
sections.en:
The AI Voice Bot page describes multilingual,multiturn conversations,parallel outbound calls,real-time suggestions and escalation with context to live agents. Unanswered calls may trigger SMS,WhatsApp or email follow-up. None of this proves a customer has agreed to a second channel,that a message was delivered or that a human was available. The embedded audio examples were not played or treated as performance evidence.

Voice Streaming separately advertises APIs/SDKs,live monitoring and redundant infrastructure. The reviewed page supplies no codec,frame format,authentication,backpressure,reconnect or timeout contract. Zero-latency and uninterrupted-service language is therefore not a measured guarantee. Pilot an interrupted audio stream,a wrong intent,a failed downstream write and no-agent escalation. Human review remains necessary for transcripts,scores and sensitive actions.
sections.zh:
AI Voice Bot页描述多语言、多轮会话、并行外呼、实时建议及带上下文转真人，无人接听可触发短信、WhatsApp或邮件跟进。这不证明客户同意第二渠道、消息已送达或人工可用；未播放嵌入音频，也未视作性能证据。

Voice Streaming另宣传API／SDK、实时监控及冗余设施，但已读页未提供编解码、帧格式、认证、背压、重连或超时契约，因此零延迟及不中断不是实测保证。应试跑音频中断、错误意图、下游写入失败及无客服转接；转录、评分和敏感动作仍需人工复核。

sections.title_en: Price the selected services and export before the14day exit window
sections.title_zh: 按所选服务核价，并在14天退出窗口前导出
sections.en:
Published terms establish actual commercial conditions without giving a usable fixed price. Subscriptions are paid in advance and renew for an equal term;telephone and analytics services can add fees,and taxes are extra. General nonrefund rules have stated exceptions. Downgrade adjustments become account credits rather than a cash refund. Ending an account early can leave the rest of the committed subscription payable,except for the specified uncured vendor-breach case. Actual amounts,currency,seat minimum,AI usage,carrier rates and trial duration remain unknown.

The service grant is limited,revocable internal-business access,not source-code ownership. Third-party phone providers may process service data,so local hosting alone does not establish every path stays local. Export before termination is strongly recommended:after termination or an unconverted trial,the terms retain data for14days during which the customer may request export;afterward deletion may be irreversible. Port-out assistance is described as reasonable effort,not a guaranteed timeline. inTalk is an editorial fit for a team able to own integration and retention;complete portable export and reliable automatic recovery were not tested.
sections.zh:
公开条款建立真实商业条件，但未给可用固定价：订阅预付并按等长期限自动续，电话及分析可额外收费，税另计。一般不退款规则有明确例外，降级差额为账户余额而非现金。提前关闭可能仍需支付剩余承诺期限订阅，指定厂商未纠正违约除外。真实金额、币种、最低席位、AI用量、运营商费率及试用期仍未知。

服务授予有限可撤销内部企业访问，不是源码所有权。第三方电话服务商可处理资料，本地托管不证明全部路径本地。条款强烈建议终止前导出：终止或试用未转付费后保留14天，可在此申请导出，之后删除可能不可逆。迁号协助为合理努力，不是保证期限。编辑判断适合能负责集成及留存的团队，未测试完整可携导出或可靠自动恢复。
